Transport Modes

سفينة بضائع سائبة

A merchant ship designed to transport unpackaged bulk cargo such as grains, coal, ore, and cement, referenced in marine shipping contracts and cargo manifests.

Definition

A merchant ship designed to transport unpackaged bulk cargo such as grains, coal, ore, and cement, referenced in marine shipping contracts and cargo manifests.

Operational example
